### ai-path-guard | Edit file_path=__TMP__/project/.claude/agents/ai-reviewer.md

### ai-git-guard | feature bash: git status
git push --force
rc=0
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Refusing a force push (--force and --force-with-lease alike).\n\nRewriting or force-pushing shared history destroys other people's work and cannot\nbe undone from here. If this really is needed, a human does it after agreeing with\nwhoever else has the branch checked out."}}
